title: Deep Learning Models for Multilingual Hate Speech Detection
findings: The paper's findings are about the general performance of different models for multilingual hate speech detection across various resource settings, rather than specific findings related to religion. It observes that LASER + LR models perform well in low-resource settings, while BERT-based models are more effective in high-resource settings. These findings apply to the detection of all hate speech, including that directed at religious groups, which was part of the training and test data.
